description: enforce_for_delivery returns Ok(()) (with a warning log) on every DNS or fetch error path. This is correct per RFC 8461 §2: 'Sending MTAs SHOULD NOT treat a policy lookup failure as a reason to fail delivery.' A well-intentioned contributor might add hard failures on DNS timeout — resist this. The spec is clear: fetch failures must not block delivery.
title: RFC 8461 §2 non-blocking on fetch failure is correctly implemented
